$description: The standard CSS classes of the Corum styling contract (ADR-011): markup a plugin may use because the host stylesheet (web/style.css) styles it in every theme. Plugin-specific styling uses a plugin-namespaced class instead (graph-*, explorer-*; third-party plugins use their own id as the prefix). `since` is the contract version that introduced the class. The version must equal `$extensions.corum.version` in tokens.json.

content.description: Page body wrapper: padding and the readable max width.

card.description: Bordered, raised surface. Contains card-head and card-body.

meta-strip.description: Wrapping row of node metadata (state, stability, template).

empty-state.description: Centred placeholder shown instead of an empty list.

node-owner-meta.description: Small muted owner name beside a node name.

tag.description: Small bordered label. Combine with a state-*, stability-* or edge-type-tag modifier.

edge-type-tag.description: Tag modifier for an edge type; pair with edge-coloured and edgeTypeStyle(type).

chip.description: Rounded inline label for counts and filters.

template-badge.description: Badge naming a node's template; pair with node-coloured.

node-coloured.description: Derives node-tint, node-border and node-on-tint from --node-colour.

edge-coloured.description: Derives edge-tint, edge-border and edge-on-tint from --edge-colour.

quick-links.description: Row of quick-link items (the QuickLinks component).

open-in.description: Container of the Open in menu (the OpenInMenu component).

open-in-item.description: One entry of the Open in menu.

icon-sized.description: Font Awesome icon sized by the --icon-size custom property.

table-scroll.description: Horizontal scroll wrapper for wide tables.

prop-key-cell.description: Key cell of a prop-table row.

prop-empty.description: Muted placeholder for an unset property value.

node-ref-link.description: Link to another node (the NodeReference helper).

active.description: State modifier: the current item of a list, tab or button group.

selected.description: State modifier: the chosen row of a list or menu.
